accounting.name: Accounting Firm
accounting.blurb: Taxes and books for local firms. Needs a college degree.

law.name: Law Firm
law.blurb: Needs a graduate degree and the bar. Lawsuit risk is lower, the pay is higher.

realestate.name: Real Estate Agency
realestate.blurb: Commission on every closing. Booms and busts follow the housing market.

insurance.name: Insurance Agency
insurance.blurb: Sell policies and collect renewals. A big claim year hurts.

dental.name: Dental Clinic
dental.blurb: Needs a graduate degree. High pay, high equipment cost.

gym.name: Gym
gym.blurb: Memberships with churn. January is your friend.

security.name: Security Company
security.blurb: Guards on contract. Needs a clean record.

tutoring.name: Tutoring Center
tutoring.blurb: Cheap to run if you know your stuff.

fastfood.name: Fast Food Franchise
fastfood.blurb: Franchise fee plus royalties baked into costs. Volume is everything.

restaurant.name: Restaurant
restaurant.blurb: Good reviews take time; one bad review can hurt.

bar.name: Bar & Pub
bar.blurb: 21+ with a liquor license. Fights and fines are the risk.

gun.name: Gun Store
gun.blurb: Needs age 21, a spotless record and a federal license. Regulation and audit risk is high.

pawn.name: Pawn Shop
pawn.blurb: Loans and resale. Needs a clean record. Stolen-goods risk.

cardealer.name: Car Dealership
cardealer.blurb: Huge revenue, thin margin. Hurt by credit crunches.

farm.name: Farm
farm.blurb: Weather and crop prices swing wildly. Irrigation protects from drought.

gas.name: Gas Station
gas.blurb: Fuel is low margin; the store is where profit hides.

hotel.name: Hotel
hotel.blurb: Occupancy follows the economy and the seasons.

apartments.name: Apartment Building
apartments.blurb: Slow and steady rent. Vacancies and repairs are the risk.

construction.name: Construction Company
construction.blurb: Project-based. Cost overruns and injuries are the risk.

autorepair.name: Auto Repair Shop
autorepair.blurb: Skilled mechanics keep customers coming back.

trucking.name: Trucking Company (semis)
trucking.blurb: Long-haul semis. Fuel, accidents and driver shortages are the risks.

boxtruck.name: Box-Truck Delivery
boxtruck.blurb: Last-mile deliveries. Cheaper trucks, more of them.

taxi.name: Taxi / Rideshare Fleet
taxi.blurb: Cars on the road all day. Thin margins, lots of small accidents.

moving.name: Moving Company
moving.blurb: Truck plus crew. Busy in summer, damages claims in the mix.
